FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Crystal Clean Laundry Services operates as a full-service laundry and dry cleaning provider, dedicated to delivering high-quality garment care. We specialize in cleaning a wide range of fabrics, including delicate materials, and offer additional services such as minor alterations and pressing. Our facility maintains strict adherence to all local and state regulations, ensuring that we use environmentally friendly solvents and cleaning agents that meet health and safety standards. We prioritize customer satisfaction through timely service and a focus on maintaining an organized workflow that minimizes the risk of garment loss or damage. All equipment is maintained regularly, and records are kept on file for compliance verification. We also provide attended self-service options, emphasizing safety and oversight to meet regulatory requirements effectively.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 10, 2023, we experienced water damage to our dry cleaning machines due to a burst pipe, resulting in a loss of $1,500. The damage was promptly addressed, with repairs completed on March 15, 2023, and all equipment is back in operation. No ongoing issues are present.

FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Standard Safe - Class B, Grade 2, UL Listed
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing installed around the perimeter of the facility and on-site watchpersons during business hours to ensure asset protection.

reviews: I love how this dry cleaner stays on top of their equipment—every time I bring my clothes in, they have that fresh, crisp feel like they just got serviced! It's reassuring to know they're proactive about keeping their machines in great shape.

The prices are reasonable, and I love that they use environmentally friendly cleaning agents. It's great to support a business that cares about the planet!
I had a minor alteration done along with my dry cleaning, and it was perfect. Highly recommend their services for both cleaning and repairs.
The facility is clean and well-organized, making it a pleasant experience. I will definitely be returning for all my laundry needs!
